name: steamos-file-manager
description: Gerenciador de arquivos para do Decky

scripts.package: pnpm run build && rm -f steamos-file-manager.zip && rm -rf .tmp/steamos-file-manager && mkdir -p .tmp/steamos-file-manager && cp -r dist locales package.json plugin.json main.py README.md LICENSE .tmp/steamos-file-manager && cd .tmp && zip -r ../steamos-file-manager.zip steamos-file-manager && cd .. && rm -rf .tmp && echo 'steamos-file-manager.zip criado com sucesso.'
scripts.auto-package: pnpm run build && chokidar "src/**" -c 'pnpm run package'
